protocol.source: Only opposite-match existing first-division Sportec WMX/WN1; no challenge inputs, labels or video. Both games heavily reused; no independent test.
protocol.architecture: 508joint motion/shape/control features; learned64projection+LayerNorm+GELU; two64unit bidirectional GRU layers; locked dropout.25,outputLayerNorm, H/A classifier with unusedD logit, auxiliary direct-turnover head.
protocol.training: From scratch, seed143,24fixed iterations,512sampled windows/iteration,batch32; core256,context64eachside; same finite-context overlap-save inference. AdamWlr.0005,weightdecay.001,maxgradientnorm1, Xavier input/output and orthogonal recurrent gates.
protocol.supervision: Known-live H/A only; train-half inverse-sqrt spell weights from032; D/X/padding/context excluded from CE. Aux boundary BCE weight.1,positiveweight capped10; entirely known-live +-12frame valid neighbourhood, +-2frame auxiliary event target.
protocol.augmentation: Four fixed clean/shortgap/longgap/tracker-noise conditions and exact team swaps. Scaling from training observations only. No previous label input, scheduled sampling inapplicable.
protocol.variants: GRU conditional live evidence weights .25/.5/1, remaining weight040conditional live evidence. Frozen040 dead experts and031boundary decoder. One fixed final checkpoint, no epoch selection.
protocol.selection: Official four-condition mean spellF1 gain>=.003 over040; each clean/gap fold decline<=.01, noise fold no decline, deadF1 decline<=.005. Highest eligible mean. Report false-positive trade-off.
protocol.audit: Freeze one winner plus hashes before new-observation-draw audit seeds2514/2714/3118. Only winner and040 decoded; audit mean must improve or retain040, no runner-up selection.
